tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wooden bench and lifts both legs forward, pressing the soles of his bare plantigrade feet toward the viewer while leaning back on his hands.
tasks.camera: front view, slightly low angle, full body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles fully face camera, all four toes per foot clear, hands resting behind on bench visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐长椅上抬脚展示双脚脚底

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a picnic blanket, the blue tiger props himself on elbows and raises both knees, showing the yellow-padded soles of his feet as he smiles at a book propped on his chest.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both upturned soles and four toes visible; both hands and elbows supporting torso visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺毯子上屈膝读书露出脚底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on his back on a yoga mat doing a happy-baby stretch, reaching to hold his ankles so both bare soles point upward, toes spread comfortably apart.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles and all toes face camera; both hands gripping ankles visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰卧做快乐婴儿式伸展举脚

tasks.instruction: Sitting cross-legged on a cushion, the blue tiger leans back and lifts both feet off the floor, turning his soles outward to the camera while balancing a teacup on one knee.
tasks.camera: front three-quarter view, seated full body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles angled to camera with toes clear; hands and teacup visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐垫子上抬脚露底并平衡茶杯

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the edge of a bathtub with legs raised and feet pressed flat against the tiled wall, showing both padded soles as he wrings out a small towel.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles flat to wall and camera-facing, toes visible; both hands on towel visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐浴缸边双脚抵墙露脚底拧毛巾

tasks.instruction: Lying on a hammock, the blue tiger swings his legs up over the edge so both bare soles face the viewer, one paw holding the hammock rope and the other resting on his belly.
tasks.camera: low front view, full body in hammock
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles clearly lifted toward camera, four toes each visible; hands visible on rope and belly.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在吊床上抬腿露脚底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a beanbag chair with knees bent up and both soles displayed, holding a game controller in both hands close to his chest as he laughs.
tasks.camera: front view, slightly high angle, full body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both upturned soles and toes visible; both hands and controller visible at chest.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠豆袋椅屈膝露脚底打游戏

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a kitchen counter, the blue tiger pulls his knees to his chest and rests both bare feet on the countertop edge, soles facing out, while holding a mug in one paw.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera with toes clear; mug-holding hand and free hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐厨房台面抱膝露脚底拿杯子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on his stomach on a rug, bends both knees up and crosses ankles loosely, then twists to show both yellow-padded soles toward the camera while drawing on paper.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both bent soles and all toes visible; both hands on paper and pencil visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴地毯上屈膝扭身展示脚底画画

tasks.instruction: Reclining in a lounge chair, the blue tiger crosses his legs at the ankles and tilts both feet so the soles face forward, hands folded behind his head as he relaxes poolside.
tasks.camera: front view, low angle, full body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both tilted soles visible with toes; both hands behind head visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺椅上交踝抬脚露底双手枕后

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a tree stump in a park, lifts both bare feet up toward the camera in a playful stretch, and leans back with one hand planted on the stump for balance.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera, four toes per foot clear; both hands visible, one on stump.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐树桩抬脚伸展露脚底

tasks.instruction: Lying sideways on a couch, the blue tiger bends his top knee and lifts the lower foot so both soles angle toward the camera, one arm draped over the backrest and one holding a TV remote.
tasks.camera: side-front view, full body on couch
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles angled to camera, toes visible; hands on backrest and remote visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺沙发举脚露底拿遥控器

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing with legs kicked out straight, both bare soles facing the camera, gripping the ropes with both hands as a breeze ruffles his fur.
tasks.camera: front view, full body, slight upward angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both extended soles and four toes visible; both hands on swing ropes visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐秋千伸直腿双脚朝镜头

tasks.instruction: Sitting on the floor with legs extended, the blue tiger leans back on one elbow and flexes both feet so their padded soles face the viewer, other paw pointing at a map.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flexed soles and toes visible; elbow-supporting hand and pointing hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地上后仰绷脚露底并用手指地图

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines against a large floor pillow, pulls both knees up and outward like a butterfly stretch, exposing both yellow-padded soles to the camera while holding a phone.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles turned outward and visible with toes; both hands holding phone visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠大枕做蝴蝶拉伸露脚底看手机

tasks.instruction: Sitting in an outdoor folding chair, the blue tiger lifts both legs and rests his heels on a cooler, soles turned to the viewer, hands clasped over his stomach as he naps with head tilted.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera, toes clear; both clasped hands visible on stomach.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐折叠椅脚跟搭冷箱露脚底打盹

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on a bed with legs raised and feet splayed apart, both soles toward the viewer, one hand under his head and the other tossing a small ball up.
tasks.camera: top-down view, full body on bed
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both raised soles with four toes each visible; head-supporting hand and ball-tossing hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺床上举脚露底抛球玩

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low wall, the blue tiger swings both feet up and leans back, presenting his padded soles, while a small bird perches on one raised finger of his outstretched paw.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera with toes visible; bird-perched hand fingers and other hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐矮墙抬脚露底伸手让小鸟停

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a pile of cushions, the blue tiger holds a large storybook open on his lap and lifts both feet so his soles face outward, toes curling with excitement.
tasks.camera: front view, slightly high, full body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles and toes visible; both hands supporting book visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠枕堆读书抬脚露底脚趾蜷起

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a wooden dock with legs dangling, then pulls them up and plants both soles flat toward the camera, holding a fishing rod in one paw and a bucket handle in the other.
tasks.camera: front view, low angle over water
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera, toes clear; hands on rod and bucket visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐码头抬脚露底持鱼竿与桶

tasks.instruction: Lying on a massage table, the blue tiger bends both knees and lifts his feet, showing yellow soles to the camera, while folding his arms across his chest contentedly.
tasks.camera: front three-quarter view, full body on table
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both upturned soles and toes visible; both folded arms and hands visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺按摩床屈膝露脚底抱臂

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a classroom chair with one ankle on the opposite knee, then tilts both feet upward so both soles show, pencil in one hand and notebook balanced on the raised knee.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles visible despite crossed legs, toes clear; pencil hand and notebook hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐教室椅交腿抬脚露底写字

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a grassy hill, the blue tiger props his upper body on his elbows and kicks both feet up, soles toward the sky and camera, watching clouds.
tasks.camera: low front view, full body against sky
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera/sky with toes clear; both elbow hands visible on grass.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺草坡撑肘踢脚朝天露脚底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a piano bench, leans back and lifts both bare feet onto the keys, soles facing the camera, while reaching one hand toward the sheet music stand.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera over keys, toes visible; hand reaching and other hand on bench visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐琴凳双脚搭琴键露脚底

tasks.instruction: Lying on a picnic blanket under a tree, the blue tiger rolls slightly to one side but keeps both feet lifted, soles angled toward the camera, holding a sandwich in one paw.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both angled soles and toes visible; sandwich hand and supporting hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺野餐垫侧身举脚吃三明治

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor with back against a sofa, slides down until reclining, and raises both legs so his padded soles face the camera, remote in one hand.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera, four toes each visible; remote hand and free hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠沙发滑躺抬腿露脚底拿遥控

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a rooftop lounge chair, the blue tiger stretches both arms overhead and points both bare feet toward the camera, yellow soles bright in evening light.
tasks.camera: front view, low angle, full body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles and toes clear toward camera; both overhead hands visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 屋顶躺椅伸展举脚露底

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low stool, the blue tiger lifts both legs straight out, soles facing the viewer, and balances a stack of books on his shins while steadying it with one hand.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles behind book stack clearly visible with toes; balancing hand and resting hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐凳直抬腿露脚底平衡书堆

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on a towel at the beach, bends both knees up and outward, and shows both yellow-padded soles to the camera while adjusting sunglasses with one hand.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both outward soles and toes visible; sunglasses hand and resting hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 沙滩毛巾上屈膝外展露脚底扶墨镜

tasks.instruction: Curled in a large armchair, the blue tiger tucks his knees to his chest but extends both feet forward so his soles face the camera, hugging a pillow with both arms.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both extended soles and toes visible; both hugging arms and hands on pillow visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蜷坐扶手椅抱枕伸脚露底
